messages:
maria: heads up — noticed a bunch of orphan anchors in the KB scan for runtime-guide (images + anchors). pinging owners here so we can decide quick fixes before sprint end

sam: thanks — which pages exactly? I can take a look if it's small. :coffee:

maria: top offenders: /runtime/latency.md (anchor #prefetch), /runtime/caching.md (image 403), and /onboarding/getting-started.md (orphan toc fragment). docs-bot posted the scan summary earlier: https://internal/reports/kb-scan/1718239000

devon: I can grab runtime/caching.md image 403 — likely a staging CDN path. quick fix is rehost to S3 and update URL. will open a tiny PR.

maria: perfect. can you also add a note in frontmatter so the scanner ignores the temp path? something like: `kb: rehosted - 2026-03-21`
devon: yep. PR coming: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1987 — small sed and image rehost. assign @sam for review?
sam: I'll review today after stand. small nit: keep the original filename if possible so existing links that rely on exact file name don't break. if we must rename, add a redirect.

ash: FYI @maria @devon I claimed /onboarding/getting-started.md — the orphan toc fragment was from an old H2 that got removed. I can re-add the anchor and a 1-line note. will add you both to the PR. :+1:

maria: thanks ash. can we also add an owners metadata block so the docs scan can auto-assign next run? something like: `maintainers: [@ash, @sam]`

ryan: quick question — for the latency.md anchor, I remember we intentionally removed the prefetch section during the refactor. do we want to restore it or create a redirect from the old anchor to the new subsection?

jen: my vote is redirect (less churn). we can add an HTML anchor at the new section and a short note: "old prefetch anchor moved here". low risk and keeps external shortlinks intact.

maria: redirect sounds good. @ryan can you patch latency.md with the anchor redirect? tiny PR acceptable.

ryan: on it. ETA end of day. will include test link in PR description and @sam for quick sanity check.

sam: quick CR bandwidth note — I'm juggling two reviews. if you mark PRs as `size: small` in the title I can prioritize. also add the failing link screenshot in the PR body so QA can smoke test.

maria: will do. I've added labels to the issues and updated the sprint board under "docs: quick fixes".

docs-bot: (scan) New run completed: 5 anchors flagged, 3 images 403/403, 2 orphan fragments. Next scheduled: 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC.

maria: thanks everyone. summary actions: devon -> rehost image PR, ash -> restore toc anchor PR, ryan -> add redirect anchor PR, sam -> review small PRs. callout: please add `size: small` and include screenshot/test steps. ping here when PRs are up so I can batch-assign to the docs churn sprint. :rocket:
